author: Unity
description:
Learn how to build an interactive 3D building showcase in Unity Studio by repurposing a ready-made template, without C#.

Unity Studio is a web-based editor that helps teams create, collaborate on, and share interactive 3D experiences — without coding complexity. It's built for industries like manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, and architecture to bring 3D ideas to life, fast.

In this high-level overview, you'll watch Unity Studio's Car Review template transformed into an interactive building showcase, start to finish – the full workflow at speed, repurposed for an architectural experience instead of a car scene. Along the way you'll see how interactive 3D prototyping works in practice: an orbiting camera, clickable hotspots, and scene-wide lighting, all wired up with visual logic.

You'll learn how to do the following:
